framework.heading: Spending, Savings, Vault
framework.intro: Your Bitcoin is most secure when each portion has a purpose and the right level of friction.
framework.spendingDesc: Low friction and highly convenient. Diverse and multipurpose. Kept to a low amount.
framework.savingsDesc: More secure and sovereign, with a good user experience and practical accessibility.
framework.vaultDesc: Highest security and redundancy. Designed to remove single points of failure and protect long term wealth.

common.whatsappMessage: Hi Schelling Point, I want help building my Bitcoin Estate Plan under my own custody. Here's my situation:

hero.title: Bitcoin – your wealth,
hero.tagline: Money that can't be printed away, kept as safe and secure as your family.
hero.lede: We guide you to hold your own money and pass it on to your loved ones, with it in your own hands the whole time.

held.label: How it is held
held.title: Security is arranged so there is no single point of failure.
held.titleEm: Your wealth stays with your family.
held.alongside: Schelling Point, with you for life
held.d1: Different keys and codes are held by people and in places trusted and chosen by you. No single person can move the money by themselves.
held.d2: If you choose it, a proof-of-life protocol that makes your money accessible to your heirs after a time frame chosen by you.
held.d3: So no matter what happens, you always have a plan B to move or access your money.
held.d4: Written so a spouse or executor can follow it, and practised with you before the day it is needed.
held.fine: Each structure is designed around your family and your existing advisers.

inter.label: Over generations
inter.title: Family wealth has been known
inter.body: Through weak structures, heirs who don't understand what they hold, plans no one wrote down or practised, and advice that didn't fit.
inter.alt: A grandfather and his grandson picking grapes together in a vineyard in late afternoon light.
inter.solve: Schelling Point helps you avoid these common, yet easily avoidable, mistakes.

founder.body: Schelling Point was founded by Charlie Stevens. His background is actuarial: weighing risk over long time frames, and making sure the money is there when a family needs it. He has guided individuals and businesses through Bitcoin custody since 2017, in Europe and Latin America.

faq.label: Questions
faq.title: Asked,
faq.q1: Do you ever hold my Bitcoin or my keys?
faq.a1: No, not at any point. Every structure we design leaves the keys with you and the people you choose, and you can end the relationship at any time in full control.
faq.q2: I am not technical. Is this still for me?
faq.a2: Most of our clients are not. The setup is built around what you can operate and explain to your family, and every step is written down in plain language.
faq.q3: What happens to my Bitcoin if something happens to me?
faq.a3: Your family has a written recovery plan, rehearsed in advance, and a direct contact at Schelling Point to guide them through it.
faq.q4: Do you work with our lawyer and accountant?
faq.a4: Yes. We work alongside your existing advisers and take care of the Bitcoin-specific parts of the plan that sit outside their practice.
faq.a5: Yes. For larger holdings we generally recommend multi-vendor multisig, so that no single device, manufacturer or person is a point of failure.
faq.a6: No. We design the structure around what you hold. What to buy, sell or keep remains your decision.

close.label: By appointment
close.title: call Schelling Point.
close.sub: We help you add this one line to your important Bitcoin documents. If something happens, your family knows who to call. We confirm who they are, then walk them through the plan you left, step by step. We never hold your keys, so we guide; your family acts.
close.whatsapp: Or, if you prefer, a message on WhatsApp.
